name: Nullframe Ascent Specialist Rig
description: The Nullframe Ascent is built for runners whose reputation has grown enough that they no longer need to be invisible — but who still need every technical edge the clothes can provide. This is a high-visibility operative set that announces capability while hiding specifics. The primary piece is a structured moto-style jacket in deep forest green with matte-black segmented shoulder panels — the panels are reinforced synth-ceramic composite, providing genuine blunt-force and slash resistance without adding bulk. The jacket's interior is a custom holster ecosystem: two chest-mounted flat holster sleeves, a collapsed-tool rail along the left lining, and a shoulder-exit aug-power conduit that routes cleanly to a forearm chrome mount. The back panel has a wide spinal channel with an open-spine cut covered by a snap-over flap — accommodating full spinal rigs or pronounced dorsal augmentation. Beneath is a slate grey mock-neck compression shirt with integrated chrome-arm port openings at both wrists, sealed with magnetic cuffs that peel back for arm-aug access. Bottoms are tailored straight-leg trousers in matte black with micro-texture — they look corporate-adjacent from ten meters but the fabric is reinforced ripstop with a concealed thigh drop pocket on each leg. Footwear is a pointed-toe moto boot in forest green leather-analog with a steel toe cap, magnetic ankle closure, and heel-recessed blade channel. A slim fingerless glove on the right hand covers chrome knuckle augmentation.
functionality: Synth-ceramic blunt and slash resistance in shoulder panels, dual chest holster sleeves, tool rail in jacket lining, aug-power conduit from shoulder to forearm chrome, spinal rig accommodation with snap-flap cover, chrome-arm port openings at wrists, concealed thigh drop pockets, heel-recessed blade channel in boot
what_it_says: This runner has stopped pretending to be someone else. The forest green and structured silhouette reads as expensive, technical, and deliberate — closer to a Tier 4 specialist than a street operative, which is exactly the gap this outfit exploits. It says: I am paid well, I am very good at this, and I am not hiding the fact that I am armed. The reputation does the rest.
worn_by: established mid-career runners with named reputations
specialists hired for their specific skillset rather than anonymity
runners with significant visible augmentation who lean into presence over concealment
operatives working Tier 3-4 environments where looking too poor is as suspicious as looking too armed
manufacturer: Nullframe — boutique street label, Tier 3 workshop, takes clients by referral only
story_hooks: A Tier 4 corporate security team clocks the synth-ceramic shoulder panels and immediately escalates — they've seen this jacket before, in a breach report. The runner is stopped in a lobby with four guards and a very polite request to wait.

The heel-recessed blade channel is empty. The runner lost the blade on the last job and hasn't replaced it. When a job goes sideways and they reach for it out of muscle memory, the absence is a half-second that matters.

A junior runner approaches in a bar and asks where the jacket came from — too eager, too specific about the interior holster layout. Someone sent them to find out who the runner's fabricator is, and whether the design can be replicated.

physical_description.visual_profile: A deliberately high-visibility operative ensemble that reads as capable without broadcasting weaponry. The silhouette is sharp and architectural — broad structured shoulders, tapered torso, straight athletic legs. Forest green and matte black color blocking creates visual rhythm and military-adjacent aesthetic without being overtly tactical. The wearer projects confidence and augmented capability.
physical_description.fit: Tailored but not restrictive. The jacket sits structured on the shoulders with a slight drop at the sleeve; the compression shirt beneath hugs without compression-limiting movement. Trousers are straight-leg and precise, sitting at the hip with enough room for quick draw access. Boots are snug with reinforced heel and ankle.
physical_description.primary_material: Synth-ceramic composite (shoulder panels), matte-finish ballistic weave (jacket body), treated leather-analog (boots), recycled-polymer ripstop (trousers), chrome-responsive synthetic blend (glove)
physical_description.texture: Jacket exterior is smooth with segmented composite panels that catch light differently — almost quilted in appearance but rigid. Interior lining is soft technical mesh. Trousers have a subtle micro-texture that breaks light without shine. Boots are matte leather with tactile steel toe. Compression shirt is seamless and body-conforming.
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep forest green (primary — jacket, boots), matte black (segmented panels, trousers), slate grey (compression shirt), chrome accents (wrist cuffs, knuckle aug, ankle closure), muted olive undertones in the leather
physical_description.closures: Magnetic snap shoulders (quick-release for aug access), friction-fit magnetic wrist cuffs (seal-and-peel design), magnetic ankle boot closure (silent operation), snap-over spinal access flap, standard zip on jacket front
distinctive_features: Reinforced synth-ceramic segmented shoulder panels (blunt-force/slash resistant)
Interior holster ecosystem: two chest-mounted flat sleeves, left-lining tool rail
Shoulder-exit aug-power conduit routing to forearm chrome mount
Open-spine back panel cut with snap-over flap for spinal/dorsal rig accommodation
Integrated chrome-arm port openings at wrist with magnetic seal-cuffs
Fingerless right glove with chrome knuckle aug cutout
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3 functional luxury — boutique custom work, referral-only clientele, high craftsmanship but street-accessible price point for serious operators
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by augmented runners and operatives with established reputation. The wearer has moved beyond 'stay hidden' into 'show what you can do.' Signals technical competence, augmentation investment, and street credibility. Popular among security contractors, black-market couriers, and independent augmentation specialists.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine to broken-in. New pieces show perfect panel alignment and sharp creases; worn pieces develop character wear on the knuckles, slight scuff on heel channels, and fading of black matte to charcoal grey on high-contact zones. The reinforced panels age beautifully — micro-scratches in the ceramic composite read as battle-tested.
